spec.name: CONCURRENCY SYNTHETIC FIXTURE
previewAssumptions: 尺寸與結構由操作人員填寫；尚未獨立量測驗證。
未完成刀模、印刷面原點、治具與實機試印校正，不可作為直接印刷依據。
規則矩形平板；不包含圓角、異形切邊、布料垂墜或厚度變化。
使用已分類圖稿與可重複場景；RGB 螢幕預覽，非實機色彩校樣。

invariants: Acquire per-workspace local OS guard before initial state commit; retain through queued/running/generation/final write.
Busy/error returns before executor submission or state/request/progress/publication writes.
All post-creation outer writes require live acquisition plus matching taskId/inputHash/batchVersion. Old finally removes only its exact local task tuple.
Status first attempts ownership before converting orphaned queued/running to failed; a live owner is only read.
OS releases handle lock on TerminateProcess/SIGKILL; fresh API marks interrupted using existing semantics and operator explicitly resubmits.
Immutable _once request/row/terminal receipts and publication verifier unchanged; lock/progress/latest never grant availability.
Guard uses existing tenant/master folder; different tenants/masters acquire concurrently.
owner.lock persists, stores no owner metadata, is never deleted/scavenged, and existence/mtime/content is not ownership.
processConcurrency.primitive: Windows msvcrt.LK_NBLCK byte range at offset 0; Ubuntu fcntl.flock LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB; non-inheritable local file handle held for service lifecycle, closed on completion/failure/process exit.
processConcurrency.ownerMetadata: NOT_APPLICABLE: no owner metadata persisted; no timestamp-based stale deletion
processConcurrency.testOnlyStaleInjection: E/F retain old callback and replay old stop-set _run/finally after old task is terminal and new process owns workspace; no production race API.
processConcurrency.scope: Independent local Python services on one machine/local filesystem only; not distributed/network filesystem or renderer capacity certification.

processRecovery.commitPointMap:
# Existing commit-point map, before corrections

Accepted implementation: 65299811abd076645edbe1cd0777b12b63968c0b.

| Sequence | File / writer | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | RecipePreviewService.submit/_run state.json queued/running | Mutable outer operational state; request hash/task binding checked, never proves publication |
| 1 | model_batches.generate -> _once(request.json) | Immutable request identity: tenant, model, batch, revision, selections and authority snapshots |
| 2 | atomic_json(batches/<batchId>.json) initial queued then running rows | Mutable operational progress/cache; cannot confer success/availability |
| 3 | model_compositions.generate: artifact/manifest/meta validation, current authority check, published.json, latest.json; model_batches._published | Per-generation publication seal and canonical verifier establish exact artifact/selection/authority lineage; latest.json only a convenience pointer |
| 4 | _once(<rowIndex>.json) after _published | Immutable row terminal fact bound to request identity and deterministic row generation; availability still requires re-verifying publication |
| 5 | atomic_json(batches/<batchId>.json) after row receipt | Mutable progress update; crash can leave it behind the immutable receipt |
| 6 | _once(terminal.json) after all rows | Immutable outer batch terminal fact; successful outer result requires this exact successful receipt |
| 7 | RecipePreviewService._run finally state.json succeeded/failed/cancelled | Mutable service transition; cannot supersede terminal authority or fabricate success |

Restart creates a fresh service with no tasks and turns queued/running outer state into failed; no automatic submit/render. model_batches.current validates request/service/progress, creates an interrupted terminal when appropriate, overlays exact row receipts, and re-verifies succeeded publications. At the earliest request/progress gap, current code unconditionally loads missing progress; baseline harness must record actual behavior before correction.

Hard-kill can bypass finally in atomic_json/_once. Temp filenames are not authority; no scavenger or wildcard cleanup will be added. Power-loss/fsync/hostile-filesystem guarantees are outside scope.
processRecovery.correction: Absent progress only after exact request/service binding and failed/cancelled outer state is reconstructed in memory; immutable receipts and full publication verifier remain authority. Existing malformed progress/running/succeeded missing progress fail closed.
processRecovery.ciScope: Windows A/A_PROGRESS/B/C/D actual processes; Ubuntu A/A_PROGRESS/B/C actual processes. CI publication bytes and artifact validator are MOCK. D also uses a real Windows handle.
processRecovery.localScope: Round6 clean exact CODE reruns all five Windows actual termination cases. B/C use REAL Blender and the unchanged full verifier. No renderer process is killed.

reproduction.lock: CreateFileW GENERIC_READ; FILE_SHARE_READ|WRITE; DELETE sharing disabled

windowsPersistence.retryable: Windows errors 32/33; error 5 only if DELETE-access probe returns 32/33
windowsPersistence.nonRetryable: Bare access/ACL denial; non-Windows errno; ENOSPC; invalid path; serialization/encoding/write errors
windowsPersistence.terminalFailure: Propagate typed error, preserve old destination, clean owned temp; immutable _once hard-link guard unchanged

priorAcceptedRound5.scope: Historical accepted evidence; exact new CODE reruns recorded separately.

truthMatrix.githubCI: Non-Blender MOCK/unit plus six independent-process race cases, two process isolation tests, retained process recovery and Windows OS-handle tests. E/F stale write timing is test-only injection.
